item.title: CVE-2026-122093 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Strong::Random versions through 0.96 for Perl allow every later rand output to be predicted from three earlier ones.
The generator keeps its state in a single number. Each call multiplies the state by a factor derived from it, and the returned digits encode that factor, so three consecutive outputs determine the state however the generator was seeded. Outputs are also biased: the first digit after the decimal point is never zero, so rand(256) never returns 1 to 24.
An attacker who sees three consecutive outputs can predict the tokens, passwords or key bytes that the same object later issues to other users.

item.title: CVE-2026-132255 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.3.4 before 0.11.0, LLM and other dynamically priced blocks run without charge when a priced input is left at its schema default. An account with a credit balance of zero can make unlimited language-model, code-generation, and image-generation calls at the operator's expense while the platform records the usage at zero cost. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-132256 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the format Jinja filter in TextFormatter accepts an unbounded width. An authenticated user who can author or run a workflow, or supply its input, can trigger a single synchronous multi-gigabyte allocation that exhausts the executor worker's memory and degrades or denies execution for other users. There is no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-132260 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.4.2 before 0.11.0, the E2B code-execution blocks ExecuteCodeBlock, InstantiateCodeSandboxBlock, and ClaudeCodeBlock can leave sandboxes running on the operator's shared E2B credential for up to the sandbox's full timeout, while users are billed only for the block's run time. Any user with a positive credit balance can keep sandboxes running for up to 24 hours on a Pro plan for a flat 1 credit, and each run adds another sandbox. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-132271 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.11.0, template rendering is not bounded in size or time. Any signed-up user who can reach a block that takes a format string, such as Fill Text Template or Agent Output, through POST /api/blocks/{id}/execute or the external API's block-execute route, can make the REST API process allocate without bound with one request of a few dozen bytes. This can stop the process from answering any request, including its health check. There is no data read or change impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-134875 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.9
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.9 | An unencrypted RSA private key for a default HTTPS certificate is included in GeoVision GV-EBD4700 firmware V1.11 (A02-GV-EBD4700_V1.11_2026_10_13.zip) at /program/www/ssl_cert.pem and copied to /config/ssl_cert.pem during initialization. When HTTPS is enabled using the default certificate, a network on-path attacker who obtains the firmware image can use the exposed private key to present an identical certificate and intercept HTTPS traffic. HTTPS is disabled by default .
*
Only impacts deployments where an administrator enables HTTPS and retains the default certificate. Because the private key is publicly distributed in the firmware image, an on-path attacker can impersonate the device with an identical certificate fingerprint, bypassing fingerprint checks and stored certificate exceptions (potentially capturing credentials if a user clicks through the expired-certificate warning).

item.title: CVE-2026-126536 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0 | Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX tax-import workflow. item.title: CVE-2026-135768 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.

item.title: CVE-2026-129832 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5 | A flaw was found in rsyslog. item.title: CVE-2026-129839 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. item.title: CVE-2026-135328 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.8 | A flaw was found in kubevirt Containerized Data Importer (CDI). The CDI clone controller derives the CommonName of a CDI-CA-signed upload client certificate from the tenant-settable cdi.kubevirt.io/uploadClientName PVC annotation without validation, and the upload server authenticates clients only by certificate CA chain and CommonName string match, with no namespace or PVC binding. A namespace user can obtain a valid client certificate and write arbitrary data into any upload-ready PVC in any namespace whose upload Service is reachable from the cluster network, resulting in cross-namespace integrity impact on disk images used by virtual machines.

item.title: CVE-2026-135813 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.0 | A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.
